about_the_game:
Tank Operations: Diary of the War blends classic turn-based strategy with new tactical possibilities. Fight your way through historic battlefields, develop specialized units through the research system, and adapt your playstyle with unique protagonists. Use the terrain to your advantage and execute combined unit maneuvers to outwit your opponents and gain a strategic edge. The level editor allows you to create custom battlefields and share them with others—offering endless challenges!
  • Historic Battlefields: Lead your forces through the deserts of North Africa, the narrow streets of Italy, and into the heart of Berlin.
  • Deep Strategy: Plan every move carefully, adapt to shifting frontlines, and master challenging battles.
  • Expanded Campaign: Conquer new scenarios and experience a reimagined take on classic battles.
  • Customizable Units: Upgrade and modify your army through research and customization.
  • Dynamic Playstyle: Choose protagonists with unique advantages for each mission.
  • Level Editor: Create custom scenarios and share them with the community.

short_description: Experience World War II’s defining battles from a new perspective! In Tank Operations: Diary of the War, you command Allied forces through intense, turn-based warfare. Master battlefield tactics, upgrade your troops, and face an expansive campaign.
